mechanism: Ampicillin may enhance the nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity of tobramycin, and tobramycin may reduce the bactericidal activity of ampicillin in certain infections.
action: Monitor renal function, hearing, and serum tobramycin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider dosage adjustments based on renal function; use combination cautiously in patients with pre-existing renal impairment.
